beats.label: S1 · A doll from a yard sale
beats.text: Jake buys Chucky at a yard sale for an art project. When his father Lucas destroys the piece and hits him over his sexuality, Chucky murders Lucas.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the doll, the trigger for the first kill, and Jake's grief that Chucky spends the season exploiting.

beats.label: S1 · Chucky picks a target
beats.text: Placed with his uncle's family, Jake resists Chucky's push to murder his bully Lexy Cross, but a party fire and rising body count pull in Detective Kim Evans.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the Jake/Lexy alliance and the police attention that shapes every later move.

beats.label: S1 · The doll they can't kill
beats.text: Devon and Jake begin a relationship and try to burn Chucky, but Chucky transfers his soul into Caroline's replacement Tommy doll and keeps killing.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Devon as the third of the trio and establishes soul-transfer as the reason no single kill ends Chucky.

beats.label: S1 · A wider war exists
beats.text: Andy Barclay arrives to hunt Chucky, revealing a wider war; Tiffany Valentine and a Chucky-possessed Nica Pierce are already based at Charles Lee Ray's childhood home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the three legacy figures — Andy, Tiffany, Nica — who define the rest of the series.

beats.label: S1 · A doll army
beats.text: Tiffany's plan surfaces: a truckload of Good Guy dolls set to ship nationwide as killers. Chucky manipulates grieving Junior into killing his own father Logan.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The doll army is the season's real threat and drives the finale; Junior's fall shows how thoroughly Chucky has poisoned the family.

beats.label: S1 · Screening massacre
beats.text: At a public film screening Chucky goes on a killing spree; Junior stabs him but dies himself, and Andy hijacks the doll truck before Tiffany's doll takes him hostage.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The finale rearranges the board: Chucky's local body destroyed, Junior gone, Andy captured by Tiffany, doll army loose.

beats.label: S1 · Tiffany takes control
beats.text: Tiffany amputates Nica's limbs to keep Chucky from repossessing her body. At the Wheelers' graves, a gloved hand reaches for something.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Nica's imprisonment and hints another player is still active — both direct hooks into what follows.

cliffhanger.text: Chucky's Hackensack body is destroyed and Junior is dead, but Tiffany's Good Guy army survived the fight. She holds Andy at gunpoint in the truck, keeps a limbless Nica as prisoner, and an unidentified gloved figure is prowling the Wheelers' graves.
questions: Who is the gloved figure at the Wheeler graves?
Can Andy survive as Tiffany's hostage?
What does Tiffany intend to do with a limbless Nica?

characters.name: Jake Wheeler
characters.line: A grieving gay teen whose abusive father was murdered by the doll he brought home; he has refused all season to become the killer Chucky wants.

characters.name: Devon Evans
characters.line: Jake's boyfriend and true-crime obsessive; he lost his mother Detective Kim Evans in the fight against Chucky.

characters.name: Lexy Cross
characters.line: The former bully turned ally; her little sister Caroline was traumatised by Chucky's manipulation and now fixates on Good Guy dolls.

characters.name: Chucky
characters.line: The soul of serial killer Charles Lee Ray in a Good Guy doll; his Hackensack body was crushed, but many copies of him are already in transit.

characters.name: Tiffany Valentine
characters.line: Chucky's lover, publicly posing as actress 'Jennifer Tilly'; she runs the doll army and now holds Andy hostage.

characters.name: Nica Pierce
characters.line: The woman Chucky had been possessing; Tiffany cut off her limbs to keep Chucky from ever repossessing her body.

characters.name: Andy Barclay
characters.line: The lifelong Chucky hunter; captured by Tiffany after hijacking her doll truck.

characters.name: Caroline Cross
characters.line: Lexy's little sister, deeply attached to Good Guy dolls after a season of being manipulated by Chucky.

beats.label: S2 · Sent away
beats.text: Andy drives the doll truck off a cliff. Six months later Chucky detonates a bomb that kills Jake's foster brother; the trio is blamed and sent to a Catholic boarding school.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets the location and forces the trio together in the very building tied to Charles Lee Ray's past.

beats.label: S2 · Many Chuckys arrive
beats.text: The school sits inside the boarding home where Charles Lee Ray grew up. Multiple Chucky dolls arrive — a photographer scout, an aggressive killer, and a docile 'Good Chucky'.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the multi-doll structure that shapes every remaining beat.

beats.label: S2 · Twins free Nica
beats.text: Tiffany's twins Glen and Glenda find Nica held captive; Glenda helps Nica-Chucky, and Kyle Evans smuggles Nica out as Tiffany's house burns and Jennifer Tilly dies.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Nica escapes Tiffany's control, Jennifer is gone, and Tiffany's cover is destroyed — all setup for her arrest in the following season.

beats.label: S2 · Andy and the Colonel
beats.text: Andy is freed at a nearby cabin, where the group learns Dr. Mixter was Charles Lee Ray's childhood therapist and now serves the bald 'Colonel' Chucky.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Dr. Mixter, whose body-swap in the finale is the season's most important consequence.

beats.label: S2 · Exorcism gambit
beats.text: An exorcism kills Father Bryce and sends the evil Chucky to Hell; Nica-Chucky, 'Chucky Prime', is transferred into Good Chucky's body and killed by Andy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The team appears to win; the trick in the next beat is why they haven't.

beats.label: S2 · The switch they missed
beats.text: But Chucky Prime had already swapped bodies with Dr. Mixter and moved into a fresh doll. Tiffany and Glenda ship the merged twin, G.G., to England.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Chucky is secretly loose again and G.G. leaves the board — the true state of play going forward.

beats.label: S2 · Caroline chooses Tiffany
beats.text: Christmas Eve: Chucky kills Mayor Cross before Lexy kills him, and Miss Fairchild finally believes the kids. Caroline, bonded to Tiffany, willingly leaves with her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Caroline's turn is the season's real ending — she stops being a victim and becomes Tiffany's accomplice.

cliffhanger.text: Chucky, hiding inside a new Belle doll, ambushes Tiffany the moment she tries to swap souls into it — while Caroline watches and smiles. Nica has sworn revenge on Tiffany from New York, and no one else knows Chucky survived the boarding-school exorcism.
questions: Whose side is Caroline really on now that she smiles at Tiffany's attack?
Will Chucky kill Tiffany or force a body-swap on her?
How does Nica plan to make good on her threat?

characters.name: Jake Wheeler
characters.line: Still gutted by Gary's death; now believes even Chucky's soul might be redeemable, which puts him at odds with Devon.

characters.name: Devon Evans
characters.line: Jake's boyfriend, harder-line than Jake on Chucky and willing to kill him outright.

characters.name: Lexy Cross
characters.line: Fighting anxiety and clonazepam dependence; her mother Mayor Cross was just killed in front of her.

characters.name: Chucky
characters.line: The soul of Charles Lee Ray, now in a fresh Good Guy doll after body-swapping through Dr. Mixter and ambushing Tiffany.

characters.name: Tiffany Valentine
characters.line: Chucky's estranged partner; wanted for Jennifer Tilly's murders and currently under attack from the Belle doll she thought was empty.

characters.name: Caroline Cross
characters.line: Fully radicalised — chose Tiffany as her real mother and helped her escape from the Cross house.

characters.name: Nica Pierce
characters.line: Freed from Tiffany, still limbless but purged of Chucky, living in New York and hunting Tiffany.

characters.name: Miss Fairchild
characters.line: Visits the kids and believes their stories about Chucky.

beats.label: S3 · Chucky in the White House
beats.text: Chucky embeds in the White House as First Son Henry's 'Joseph' doll. Jake, Devon and Lexy spot him on TV and set out to reach him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the location and pulls the trio back into pursuit after months apart.

beats.label: S3 · Pryce covers it up
beats.text: Chucky kills a White House secretary, and agent Warren Pryce enlists First Lady Charlotte in the cover-up. Chucky then murders the kids' guardian Miss Fairchild.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Pryce becomes the season's institutional obstacle, and Miss Fairchild's death removes the trio's adult support.

beats.label: S3 · Chucky is dying
beats.text: Chucky's doll body is dying — Damballa abandoned him after the exorcism. He needs six kills at an 'evil' site to renew himself, and picks the White House.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the season's engine: every escalation from here is Chucky racing his own decay.

beats.label: S3 · Tiffany on death row
beats.text: Tiffany is tried as Jennifer Tilly for Chucky's murders and sentenced to death. On death row she receives voodoo dolls and starts plotting an escape.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Runs the Tiffany track parallel to the White House plot and sets up her return in the finale.

beats.label: S3 · Nukes and a dying doll
beats.text: Chucky murders President Collins and nearly launches nuclear missiles from the Situation Room before his doll disintegrates. His spirit crosses into the afterlife.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's midpoint reversal — the doll fails but Chucky moves to a plane where the kids can't reach him.

beats.label: S3 · Possession in transit
beats.text: Jake enters the spirit realm in cardiac arrest to finish Chucky, but Chucky Prime uses the opening to possess Jake's body. Tiffany escapes execution via a hypnotised guard.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Chucky is now inside Jake — the deception the finale hinges on — and Tiffany is loose to complete the reunion.

beats.label: S3 · Caroline's ritual
beats.text: At doll maker Wendell Wilkins' house, Caroline transfers Jake back to himself — then puts him, Devon and Lexy into marionette dolls as Tiffany and Chucky drive off.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The final state of every major character is set here; this is the situation the next season opens into.

cliffhanger.text: Jake, Devon and Lexy are trapped in marionette-doll bodies inside Wendell Wilkins' workshop while Chucky, Tiffany and Caroline drive off together as a family. Nica has just wheeled herself in — and Wendell is standing right behind her.
questions: Can Jake, Devon and Lexy get out of the marionette bodies?
What does Wendell want with Nica?
Where are Chucky, Tiffany and Caroline going now that they're reunited?

characters.name: Jake Wheeler
characters.line: Trapped in a marionette doll after Caroline's ritual at Wendell's workshop; briefly possessed by Chucky Prime before being transferred back.

characters.name: Devon Evans
characters.line: Also trapped as a marionette; his relationship with Jake is now fully committed.

characters.name: Lexy Cross
characters.line: Trapped as a marionette; connected with First Son Grant Collins during the White House break-in.

characters.name: Chucky
characters.line: Renewed after nearly dying; back in a fresh doll body and driving away with Tiffany and Caroline as a reunited family.

characters.name: Tiffany Valentine
characters.line: Escaped death row via a hypnotised guard; now inhabiting Wendell's prototype Belle doll and reunited with Chucky.

characters.name: Caroline Cross
characters.line: Chucky and Tiffany's fully devoted acolyte; performed the soul transfers that trapped Jake, Devon and Lexy.

characters.name: Nica Pierce
characters.line: Testified against Tiffany and watched her execution attempt; has just rolled herself into Wendell's workshop.

characters.name: Wendell Wilkins
characters.line: The doll maker who originally created the Good Guys; approached Nica from behind with unknown intent.

characters.name: Grant Collins
characters.line: The First Son who chose to help the trio and locked Pryce inside the burning Oval Office.
